propositions: A vendored Dockerfile must be built locally from the addono/jira-software-standalone base pinned by digest, with mandatory AMPS entrypoint flags -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout to prevent silent startup failures on slow or emulated runners

The harness serves a real Jira 8.17.1 Server at http://localhost:2990/jira with personal access token authentication exercised via programmatic token creation and bearer auth requests, proving DC REST v2 semantics and auth modes are exercised not assumed

A readiness probe with a generous, overridable timeout (default 20 minutes) must poll the instance on a native amd64 runner where emulation is avoided; arm64 hosts run the base image under emulation and materially exceed upstream's quoted 3-5 minute startup

The harness must be gated behind structural enforcement (external tier, _live_jira_ready sentinel, auto-applied jira_live marker, all-skip canary) such that missing the instance skips cleanly, every test collected but none executed triggers a session failure, and integration marker is forbidden to prevent accidental per-commit CI inclusion

Teardown verification must use direct issue endpoints (/rest/api/2/issue/{key}) to poll for 404s rather than search queries, following ADR 0037 §3 discipline that search indexes lag creates and deletes by unbounded intervals

A new external-integration.yml job on native amd64 (ubuntu-latest) must build the harness, wait on readiness, run only the live tests, and tear down under if: always(), with the pre-existing cloud-creds job modified to --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc so each job's canary guard detects its own tier's all-skip condition
